readiness.criterion: A lead created from the form gets the right channel and source, is assigned in the right round-robin order, and the manager is notified.

Reminder steps at 60 minutes, 24 hours, 3 hours and 60 minutes before the visit, and 15 days are created at the right time; overdue steps appear in "Today's tasks" and count as late in the audit; the "Báo Studio" step creates a task for the coach manager.

readiness.criterion: The consulting dashboard gives the right lead counts, booking rate, and show rate per consultant when compared with the Excel files of September and October 2026.
One person goes through lead → appointment → show → contract → session with a single record.
Entering any session count gives the right tier unit price, end date, and display name; a price different from the tier flags the contract "Exception price" and it cannot be activated until approved.
An approved contract cannot be edited, even by admin; a contract not yet approved cannot be booked.
Deleting a contract with receipts is blocked and the receipts to delete first are listed; after deleting in the right order, total receipts and revenue fall by exactly the deleted amounts.
Deleted data is in the trash with its reason, viewable only by management, and cannot be deleted.

A frozen contract cannot be booked or checked in; reactivation shows the frozen days and the proposed new end date; the end date changes only after admin confirms and is never extended twice; a freeze over 10 days reminds the manager.

"Đã tập" and no-show reduce sessions left by exactly 1 and credit the PT; "Hủy lịch" and delete do not; each status shows its color; booking is refused when no sessions are left, the contract has expired, or times overlap.

A session in "Đã tập" cannot change status; when admin deletes it, the customer gets exactly 1 session back and the PT exactly 1 credit less; if its period was already paid, the next period has an adjustment line.
Every credited or refunded session sends exactly one email to the customer, from the template and in the right language, with its sending status stored in the customer profile.
The PT revenue allocation report matches GymMaster's export on the same data; PT payout vouchers never pay a session twice.
Each contract's paid amount and debt always equal the sum of its valid receipts; cash book closing balance equals opening balance plus receipts minus expenses.
A customer's plans and every session log are visible in their profile, with plan and actual on the same row; choosing a Cardio exercise shows time, speed, and heart rate.
Choosing Action "Stop + Escalation" notifies the manager and Master, and the item stays in the waiting list until handled; the weekly workout dashboard gives the right Flag and Action percentages.
Data imported from GymMaster matches the number of customers, contract value, paid amounts, and sessions left.
The lead, PT calendar, and session log screens work on a phone.
A PT can book outside the on-duty shift, and the grid colors in-shift and off-shift time differently (D-058).
A lead needs only a name and a channel; the country is chosen from the list of countries and the email goes in the language derived from it (D-057, D-060).
Leads are shared by turn weight; a lead not taken care of after 1 working hour moves on, never outside 08:30–20:30, and each move is in the history and the dashboard (D-050, D-052).
A ticked checklist step cannot be unticked; an overdue step past its grace period locks as "Không thực hiện" and cannot be ticked late (D-054).
A task is reminded at all three points before its deadline through the bell, email, and phone, and a slow approval past 24 hours is told to the approver's direct manager (D-053, D-056, D-048).

Simulated scans through the API: a pair of the customer and the right PT within 15 minutes and the pairing window turns the session to *Đã tập* and triggers the session taken, the PT credit, and the email; a missing side hangs the session with the right reason; a scan with no booking is an error; a customer training twice with two PTs needs a pair for each (D-069, D-070).
A session without a full check-in is notified to its PT at the end of the day, and to the Studio Manager with a task after 24 hours (D-071).
